inlines.v: BLINDLY, adverb Without sight, or understanding. 1. Without discerning the reason; implicitly; without examination; as, to be blindly led by another. 2. Without judgment or direction. BLINDMAN'S BALL, noun A species of fungus, Lycoperdo, or puff-ball. BLINDMAN'S BUFF, noun A play in which one person is blindfolded, and hunts out the rest of the company.
